scope: Deterministic pagination: convergence on two identical height snapshots + stable table column widths

implementation.convergence: measureWordHeights builds a snapshot of paragraph heights and per-table-row heights; pagination is considered final after two consecutive identical snapshots, otherwise it re-measures (cap 20 passes). Stage exposes data-settled/data-measure-attempts for QA
implementation.tableSignature: Rows are grouped per table block before comparing snapshots, so page fragmentation boundaries cannot change the signature
implementation.fixedTableLayout: w:tblGrid is parsed into percentage column widths, rendered as <colgroup>, and .op-word-table uses table-layout: fixed; column widths no longer vary per page fragment (the main source of row-height oscillation)
implementation.nestedTables: Nested tables no longer inherit data-block, so row measurement/pagination only sees top-level table rows

runtimeQA.script: qa-pagination-twice.mjs (loads sample-real-proposal.docx twice in fresh pages and waits for data-settled)
